name: @orca/e2e-tests
description: End-to-end tests for the local Orca Managed Agents stack — drives registry-service-ts via the official Anthropic SDK + raw HTTP fallback. Requires `make stack-up`.

scripts.test:wire: bash ../../services/dev/scripts/with-dev-env.sh vitest run test/wire-conformance.spec.ts test/trigger-wire.spec.ts test/multi-workspace-isolation.spec.ts test/transcript-visibility.spec.ts test/session-threads.spec.ts test/apicall.spec.ts test/internal-auth.spec.ts test/guardrails-wire.spec.ts test/model-prices-wire.spec.ts test/budget-wire.spec.ts
scripts.test:agent:sandbox: ORCA_E2E_SANDBOX_HARNESS=1 bash ../../services/dev/scripts/with-dev-env.sh vitest run --retry 1 test/custom-tool-result-assertions.spec.ts test/sandbox-harness-agent.spec.ts test/sandbox-harness-multiagent.spec.ts test/guardrails-budget-agent.spec.ts
scripts.test:spend: bash ../../services/dev/scripts/with-dev-env.sh vitest run --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 test/spend-control.spec.ts test/spend-subagents.spec.ts test/spend-runner.spec.ts
